text:
elaine: FYI, ACME is asking for a 3x committed throughput bump for Q3 (from 20k tps -> 60k). They want it in us-east-1, AZ-constrained. Can we hit that without new racks? cc @jen

jen: Are they asking guaranteed sustained throughput or just peak? Need wording for contract.

elaine: Guaranteed 99th p95... sustained for business hours. They also refused cross-AZ fallback due to data locality.

raj: That's tough. If no AZ failover, we need dedicated pools in single AZ. What's current headroom in us-east-1a?

tom: Quick check: current reserved across us-east-1a: 28 GPUs reserved, utilization avg 58% peak 82% last week. With 60k tokens/s estimate -> ~48 GPUs (w/ batching/quant). Need network egress and NVLink headroom too.

jen: Customer is OK with quantized models (int8) but wants <120ms p95. Can we keep latency with that many users in single AZ?

raj: Latency wise possible if we spread across multiple instances and tune batching. But single-AZ failure domain still risky. Also cloud billing spike: reserved capacity commit will blow monthly baseline.

infra-bot: [auto] projection calc updated: https://docs.internal/redwood/commits/q3-acme-proj (csv attached)

elaine: Link has numbers but need ops signoff. Options: 1) Accept 3x commit as single-AZ with strict SLAs + price uplift; 2) Offer 2x committed + burst to 3x using spot/dedicated burst; 3) Keep 2x and require cross-AZ fallback.

tom: Option 2 cheapest but operational complexity: spot fallback for burst; need automated reroute and model variant fallback. Also network egress locality — cross-AZ might cost more.

raj: Pricing note: If we commit for single-AZ we may need to provision dedicated hosts (no preemptibles) — higher cloud commit. Recommend Option 3 as default with an addendum allowing seasonal single-AZ reservations at premium.

jen: Customer will push back on cross-AZ. I'll run negotiation with legal: premium for single-AZ + SLA fees. Also confirm they'd accept a 30% penalty if we fail single-AZ.

ops-oncall: For runbook: if single-AZ overloaded, trigger autoscale-burst -> route to reserved-burst pool in us-east-1b if allowed; otherwise throttle and engage account team.

elaine: Action items: @raj calc GPU count & cost delta for single-AZ vs multi-AZ by EOD; @tom check latency perf with int8 at projected load; @jen get initial commercial terms draft.

raj: Will post numbers in thread (ETA 18:30 UTC).

tom: I'll spin a perf job on staging (script below) and post results.

tom: ```bash
# perf-run snippet
python infra/load_test.py --model redwood-large --quant int8 --qps 60000 --az us-east-1a --concurrency 200
```

elaine: Great. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jen: Ping me if you want me to join customer call tomorrow.
